source_limitations: Publisher-owned Cambridge search-indexed English dictionary excerpts observed 2026-10-28; direct full-page access returned HTTP 403. These are editorial source leads, not direct full-page verification, not independently approved exact-sense/CEFR/English/Myanmar/example review. No copyrighted dictionary definitions copied into learner content. All canonical drafts and production assets unchanged.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Not controlled by another person or organisation.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အမှီအခိုကင်းသော၊ လွတ်လပ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The team made an independent decision.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge marks freedom from another person's control or influence B2, while B1 is not needing help. The B1 draft's independent decision uses autonomy from control, not self-sufficiency.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Verify whether the independent decision refers to autonomous judgement (B2); independently replace or justify B1 with a credible exact-sense B1 source.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A strong effect that something has on a situation.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: သက်ရောက်မှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The new policy had an impact on small businesses.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels a strong effect on a person or situation B2; the draft policy's impact on businesses is that effect, not physical collision.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Require independently supported B1 sense or retier/replace; check Myanmar gloss distinguishes influence from collision.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Producing the result that was wanted.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ထိရောက်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Regular practice is an effective way to learn.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels achieving a desired result B2; the draft describes regular practice as a successful method.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Check a direct B1 exact-sense reference or retier/replace; independently validate example and natural Myanmar.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A careful examination of information to understand it.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အသေးစိတ် ခွဲခြမ်းစိတ်ဖြာလေ့လာမှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The team completed an analysis of the survey results.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels the careful examination of information B2; the survey-results example uses this detailed-study sense.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently assess B1 placement and whether an alternative easier B1 noun is preferable.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Made of many connected parts and difficult to understand.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ရှုပ်ထွေးသော၊ အစိတ်အပိုင်းများစွာပါဝင်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The engineer explained the complex process clearly.

publisher_source.source_sense_heading: adjective (MANY CONNECTED PARTS / HARD TO UNDERSTAND)
publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels both many-related-parts and difficult-to-understand adjective senses B2; the draft combines these two related B2 aspects.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently review level, avoid conflating with C1 building-complex noun, and replace/retier if B1 cannot be substantiated.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Extremely important for success or safety.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အလွန်အရေးကြီးသော၊ မရှိမဖြစ်လိုအပ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Clean drinking water is critical during an emergency.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels the extremely-important adjective sense B2; draft emergency-water example is about importance, not critical illness or negative criticism.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently substantiate B1 or replace/retier; check precise Burmese distinction from negative criticism.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Needed in order to achieve something.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: လိုအပ်သော၊ မဖြစ်မနေလိုအပ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Is a ticket necessary for this event?

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels required-for-a-result adjective B1; the draft question about whether a ticket is needed matches.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently confirm direct source, English definition, Myanmar meaning and natural question grammar.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The tools or machines needed for a particular activity.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ကိရိယာပစ္စည်းများ၊ အသုံးအဆောင်စက်ပစ္စည်းများ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The team checked its safety equipment before entering the site.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels the collective uncountable tools/gear noun B1; draft safety-equipment use fits and does not pluralise equipment.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently verify uncountable grammar, original Myanmar translation and example.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A formal request for a job, course, or permission.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Please submit your application before Friday.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels the formal request noun B1, while computer-program sense is B2 in the Learner's Dictionary; draft submit-your-application context is a request.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Confirm Myanmar refers to application/request, not a mobile app; independently verify original example and exact sense.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The reason why something is done or exists.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ရည်ရွယ်ချက်၊ အကြောင်းရင်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The purpose of the meeting is to agree on a delivery date.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge Learner's Dictionary labels why something is done B1; draft meeting's purpose is this reason, not the 'on purpose' idiom.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently check the reason/aim Myanmar gloss and meeting-example grammar.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A way of dealing with or solving a problem.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ပြဿနာဖြေရှင်းနည်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The team proposed a practical solution to reduce waste.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels answer-to-a-problem B1; draft waste-reduction proposal uses this sense, not the chemical-mixture sense.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Confirm that the original Myanmar gloss refers to problem-solving rather than a liquid mixture.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: If not; used to explain what will happen without a particular action.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: မဟုတ်လျှင်၊ သို့မဟုတ်ပါက
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Leave now; otherwise, you may miss the train.

publisher_source.source_sense_heading: conjunction (IF NOT / OR ELSE); adverb (EXCEPT) B2
publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels the conditional result after a command or suggestion as B1 under conjunction; draft uses 'Leave now; otherwise, you may miss the train' but records part_of_speech as adverb. Its separately labelled adverb 'except' sense is B2.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independently resolve whether conditional connector is a conjunction or sentence adverb for the intended syllabus; do not equate the B1 conjunction label with B1 adverb approval.
